name: 3d-scene-composer
description: A self-hosted web app for composing 3D scenes from a personal library of GLB models

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "server,client" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: node scripts/update-version.js && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
